topic: Sending Messages with Movement, Sound, and Light
key_concepts: Hand and body gestures can send messages without words
Common Filipino gestures have specific meanings
Sound patterns can be used to send information
The gandingan or talking gongs imitate speech tone and rhythm to communicate
Morse code uses patterns of short and long beeps to send messages
Traffic light colors communicate stop, slow down, or go
Fire beacons and smoke signals send visible messages over distance
Lighthouses use light to communicate with ships
Movement, sound, and light can be used as signals to send messages over distance
